THE HEALING

The creature's skin is elastic: the moment you let go, the dent unwinds and the squeezed water flows away, fading to zero in a few seconds. Wake any cell past 0.02 MPa, then take your hand off and simply wait. Nothing heals while you keep holding; the healing begins when you let go.

PASSED — you let go, and the body healed itself. it never needed you.
